en:
Gonta know he see tiny bug other day...
Why it not come out today...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Gonta for a while?
Oh! Gonta should set up bug bait!
Shuichi, can you come help Gonta make bait?

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time hunting bugs
with Gonta...

<CLT=cltMIND>We no catch any...
Maybe Gonta just seeing things?
<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta and I grew a little closer today.
